description: This file defines the abstract class AbstractConfigurationProvider within the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides base methods for configuration providers, including caching, chaining, and environment-specific file location logic, as well as promise-based asynchronous operations.

classes.name: AbstractConfigurationProvider
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for AWS SDK configuration providers, including caching, chaining, environment handling, and promise-based configuration retrieval.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Wraps a configuration provider with caching support. Checks the cache before invoking the provider and updates the cache with the new configuration if not found.

methods.name: chain
methods.description: Creates a composite provider that invokes multiple providers sequentially until one returns a configuration.

methods.name: getHomeDir
methods.description: Determines the user's home directory based on environment variables, supporting Linux/Unix and Windows.

methods.name: getDefaultConfigFilename
methods.description: Returns the default AWS config file location, either from environment variable or default path.

methods.name: memoize
methods.description: Wraps a provider to cache its result for repeated use, ensuring the configuration is retrieved only once.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Returns a rejected promise with a standardized exception message.
